**Motion Designer Needed – Premium Animated Video Ads for Digital Agency**

We’re looking for an experienced motion designer to create professional video ads for Low Cost Digital, an Irish digital agency.

Each ad will be approximately **23 seconds long**. We will provide wording, branding, **visual storyboard mockups for all four ads**, and an attached reference video showing the animation standard required.

**Style Required**

Sleek, modern motion graphics combining strong imagery with animated text and interface elements, including:

- Feature blocks and icons sliding in and out.
- Search-bar typing with a blinking cursor.
- Animated campaign dashboards, ad previews and enquiry notifications.
- Website previews inside laptop, tablet and phone mockups.
- Smooth transitions, subtle background movement and clear closing calls to action.

The reference uses **kinetic typography and UI-style motion graphics**. We cannot confirm which software or coding was used. You can use your preferred workflow, provided the finished result meets the same visual standard.

**Please review the attached example before quoting.** Our ads must match its level of polish, readability and animation quality, using our own branding and designs. We want more than a slideshow with basic text fades.

**Scope and Pricing**

Please quote separately for:

1. **One completed video ad**, approximately 23 seconds.
2. **A package of four completed video ads**, approximately 23 seconds each:

| Ad | Service and Audience |
|---|---|
| **Web Design** | Our complete website solution for businesses, including design, domain, hosting, business email, SEO foundations and support. |
| **Tradespeople** | Ads management for construction businesses, carpenters, electricians and similar trades. |
| **Landscapers** | Ads management specifically for landscaping businesses. |
| **General Ads Management** | Ads management for retail, ecommerce, service businesses and other industries. |

The three ads management videos can share a consistent animation structure, with industry-specific backgrounds, example ads and wording. The web design video follows its own supplied storyboard.

All four must clearly promote **our agency’s services to business owners**.

**Images and Footage**

Our mockups provide the visual direction, scene layouts and examples of the imagery required.

**Ideally, you will source suitable, professionally licensed stock images or footage for the Landscapers, Tradespeople and General Ads Management videos**, matching or improving on the quality shown in our mockups.

Please confirm whether this is included in your quote. Any stock licensing costs must be stated upfront, and the licence must cover our use of the finished videos in paid social advertising.

**Deliverables**

Include the following in both prices:

- **1080 × 1350 portrait version** for Facebook/Instagram Feeds.
- **1080 × 1080 square version** for Facebook Feed/Marketplace use.
- **1080 × 1920 vertical version** for Reels/Stories.
- Layouts properly adapted to each format, keeping text and buttons clear of interface overlays.
- High-quality MP4 exports, licensed background music and subtle sound effects.
- Clear messaging when viewed without sound.
- Editable project/source files and any required assets.
- At least two rounds of revisions.

Timing labels and production notes on our storyboards must not appear in the finished ads.

**When Applying, Please Provide:**

- Two or three relevant examples of animated video ads you have created.
- Your price for one ad and for all four, including all formats above.
- Your turnaround time for the first draft and completed package.
- The software/workflow you use.
- Whether sourcing licensed images, footage and music is included.
- Your revision allowance and any additional costs.

We’re looking for someone who can turn our supplied mockups into polished, visually engaging ads, with further work available if the quality is right.

Project Title
Professional Executive PowerPoint Presentation – Urban Utilities NG4D Lunch & Learn (Water Infrastructure & Capital Delivery)

Project Overview
We are seeking an experienced PowerPoint presentation designer to create a professional executive-level presentation for delivery to senior stakeholders within the Australian water infrastructure sector.
The presentation will be delivered to the Urban Utilities NG4D (Next Generation Delivery) Program in Brisbane and will be attended by:
* Urban Utilities personnel
* Downer delivery teams 
* Stantec design teams 
* Program Managers 
* Project Managers 
* Construction Managers 
* Design Managers 
* Senior Engineers 
* Asset Planning stakeholders 
This is not a traditional sales presentation.
The objective is to position CNS Engineering as a trusted partner capable of improving:
* Service continuity 
* Network resilience 
* Project constructability 
* Delivery certainty 
* Customer outcomes 
* Capital project efficiency 
The presentation will blend thought leadership with practical methodologies and technologies used within the water industry.

Presentation Objective
The audience should leave thinking:

"We should be considering service continuity and isolation strategy much earlier in planning and design."

and

"CNS possesses specialist expertise and methodologies that may help improve project outcomes."


Presentation Style
The presentation should resemble the style and quality typically seen from:
* Stantec 
* Aurecon 
* Jacobs 
* Arup 
* GHD 
Characteristics:
Executive-level
Modern consulting style
Infrastructure-focused
Visually clean
Strong storytelling
Minimal text
Infographic heavy
Editable PowerPoint format
Avoid:
Product catalogue look
Excessive technical detail
Marketing-heavy language
Clipart or generic templates

Presentation Structure
The deck is already storyboarded and will follow a three-act narrative.
ACT 1 – THE CHALLENGE
Slides 1–7
Topics include:
* Industry pressures 
* Capital delivery challenges 
* Cost of consequence 
* Shutdown risk 
* Service continuity impacts 

ACT 2 – A DIFFERENT APPROACH
Slides 8–19
Topics include:
* Customer-centric isolation planning 
* Service continuity reviews 
* Project lifecycle integration 
* Maturity model 
* Major trunk main lessons learned case study 
* Stakeholder benefits 

ACT 3 – PRACTICAL PATHWAYS
Slides 20–26
Topics include:
* Isolation strategy toolkit 
* Decision matrix 
* S-Gate applications 
* HydraCut applications 
* Future technologies 
* NG4D opportunities 
* Key takeaways

Custom graphics to be developed including:
Presentation Roadmap
3-act structure diagram

Visible Costs vs Hidden Consequences

Critical → Commercial → Residential

Planning → Design → Delivery → Operations
Delivery Maturity Model
Level 1 – Reactive

* Trunk main connection schematic 
* Escalation of consequence flow 
* Lessons learned summary 
* Stakeholder value graphic 
Isolation Toolkit Wheel
Graphical representation of methodologies
Methodology Decision Matrix
Project consequence vs intervention methodology

Final Takeaway Graphic
Summary framework and QR code integration

Deliverables
Required
* 26-slide PowerPoint deck 
* Fully editable .pptx file 
* Slide master/template 
* Custom graphics 
* Consistent visual identity 
* Presentation-ready format 
Preferred
* Icons editable 
* Graphics editable 
* Consistent animation/transitions (minimal) 

Source Material
The full content architecture, speaker notes and storyline will be provided.

The selected freelancer's role is to:

* Translate content into a professional visual presentation 
* Improve visual storytelling 
* Create graphics and layouts 
* Enhance engagement

Photography Project Brief

* Theme: Recycling and Sustainability.
* Concept: Transforming discarded plastic materials into something beautiful and meaningful.
* Main Subject: A recycled plastic bottle creatively repurposed as a flower pot, containing fresh and colourful flowers.
* Photography Style: Fine art photography with a minimalist and aesthetic approach.
* Composition: Using natural surroundings, reflections, greenery and soft lighting to create visually appealing photographs.
* Colour Palette: Soft pink, natural green, earthy brown and subtle neutral tones.
* Lighting: Natural lighting to highlight the flower pot and create a calm atmosphere.
* Message: To encourage people to recycle, reuse materials and appreciate the beauty of giving unwanted objects a second chance.
* Editing: Enhance sharpness, brightness, contrast and details while maintaining a natural appearance.

Full Description

This photography project explores the importance of recycling and sustainability through creative visual storytelling. It focuses on transforming an ordinary discarded plastic bottle into a beautiful flower pot, demonstrating how waste materials can be repurposed into something useful and meaningful. By incorporating natural elements such as flowers, greenery, reflections and soft lighting, the photographs aim to capture the beauty of recycling in everyday life. The project also conveys a deeper message that something once considered worthless can become valuable again when given a second chance. Ultimately, it hopes to raise environmental awareness and inspire people to adopt more sustainable habits.

full_description:
Freelance Discord & Mastodon Community Manager
About the project

We are a publisher and bookstore offering print books, ebooks, audiobooks, music, and marketing packages for self-publishing authors. We’re looking for one highly experienced freelancer to set up and manage a coordinated social program on both Discord and Mastodon.

This is a hands-on role. We need someone who has recently worked directly in both platforms—not someone who has only general social-media experience or is proposing to learn them on the job.
Mandatory recent experience

Do not apply unless you have worked directly in both Discord and Mastodon within the last six months.

To be considered:

 Your freelancer profile must clearly describe recent, hands-on work with both Discord and Mastodon, including when you used each platform and what you did.
 If your profile does not include that information, provide a detailed account in your proposal. Include the project or organization, your role, the dates you worked on each platform, the size or type of community, and specific results or responsibilities.
 Provide verification information for at least one company or organization you worked with on these platforms. With its permission, include the organization’s name, a contact person and business email, or other verifiable evidence of your role. Do not disclose confidential client information or share private server access.
 Clearly state whether you personally handled the work on both platforms. Agency or team experience alone is not enough unless you personally performed the work.

Applications that don’t meet these requirements will not be considered.
Scope of work
Discovery and strategy

 Review our bookstore, publishing, music, and self-publishing marketing services.
 Recommend the target audiences and positioning for each platform.
 Develop a practical strategy that distinguishes Discord’s community and event role from Mastodon’s public posting and discovery role.
 Recommend an achievable content and moderation schedule.

Discord setup and management

 Set up and organize a branded community server, including channels, roles, permissions, welcome information, rules, onboarding, and moderation procedures.
 Create a structure that can serve readers, audiobook listeners, music fans, authors, and self-publishing creators without overwhelming new members.
 Plan and manage activities such as book discussions, author or artist Q&As, bookstore events, and educational sessions for independent creators.
 Welcome members, encourage conversation, enforce community rules, and escalate sensitive or business-related issues to us.

Mastodon setup and management

 Advise us on account setup and suitable instance considerations; we will make the final account and instance decisions.
 Develop the profile, bio, links, pinned welcome post, and initial posting approach.
 Create and publish posts about bookstore recommendations and events, books, ebooks, audiobooks, music, authors, and useful self-publishing guidance.
 Participate appropriately in conversations with readers, authors, booksellers, and relevant communities.
 Use relevant hashtags and accessible practices, including descriptive image text.

Content, reporting, and improvement

 Create a monthly content calendar and draft posts for our review.
 Coordinate posts and events across Discord and Mastodon without simply duplicating the same message everywhere.
 Track meaningful outcomes, such as active participation, event attendance, relevant audience growth, website or event-page visits, and qualified inquiries about our services.
 Provide a concise monthly report with results, observations, and recommended changes.
 Keep community resources, channel descriptions, moderation guidance, and account documentation organized and up to date.

Required skills and experience

Please describe your level and give examples for each area.

 Discord setup and administration — expert: hands-on experience configuring servers, channels, roles, permissions, onboarding, moderation, and community events.
 Mastodon account and community management — expert: recent direct experience publishing, engaging, using hashtags, and understanding how instances and federation affect participation and discovery.
 Community management — advanced: able to welcome and retain members, prompt useful discussion, handle conflict calmly, and apply clear moderation standards.
 Content planning and writing — advanced: can write engaging, brand-appropriate posts for readers, creators, authors, musicians, and local bookstore customers.
 Event coordination — advanced: can plan and promote online and bookstore-linked events, manage schedules, and follow up afterward.
 Analytics and reporting — intermediate or better: can choose realistic measures, interpret results, and recommend improvements without relying on follower counts alone.
 Organization and communication — advanced: dependable, responsive, comfortable working to an approval process, and able to flag risks or delays promptly.
 Accessibility and inclusion — working knowledge: writes clear, welcoming content and uses accessible image descriptions and inclusive community practices.

What we will provide

We will provide the freelancer with:

 Information about our business, products, audience, services, and priorities.
 Brand guidelines, logos, approved images, and relevant links where available.
 Access to the appropriate business contacts for questions, approvals, and escalation.
 Timely review of content and decisions that require our approval.
 The final decisions on pricing, business claims, promotional offers, moderation policy, and account ownership.

The freelancer must not invent product details, publish unapproved claims, make commitments on our behalf, change pricing, or promise results for marketing services. We expect them to obtain approval for sensitive, controversial, paid, or high-impact content.
Deliverables

Please propose a schedule and price for the following initial work:

 A short strategy and recommended channel/account structure.
 A configured Discord server and a prepared Mastodon profile.
 A written moderation and escalation guide.
 A first-month content and event calendar.
 Initial welcome materials and launch posts for both platforms.
 A monthly management and reporting plan.

We expect the freelancer to continue managing and improving the program after setup. In your proposal, specify your availability, estimated hours per week, what is included in your ongoing fee, and any work that would be billed separately.
How to apply

Please include:

 A brief introduction and your proposed approach for these two platforms.
 Evidence of direct Discord and Mastodon work within the last six months, including dates and your personal responsibilities on each.
 At least one organization or company that can verify relevant work, with permission to contact it—or another credible verification method.
 Examples of communities or content you managed, with links or screenshots only where you have permission to share them.
 Your proposed setup timeline, weekly availability, and rates.
 A short explanation of how you would keep community-building useful and welcoming without making the platforms feel like constant advertisements.

Applications without clear recent hands-on experience on both Discord and Mastodon will not be considered.

We are looking for an experienced Python Django REST Framework (DRF) Backend Developer to migrate our existing backend application integrations from Microsoft Azure to AWS.

Our DevOps Engineer will handle AWS infrastructure provisioning, configuration, networking, deployment and cloud administration.

The freelancer will be responsible exclusively for backend code modifications, AWS service integrations, database connectivity, application compatibility, debugging and testing.

1. Azure Storage to AWS S3

Modify existing Django storage integrations to use Amazon S3.

Configure Django storage backend using boto3 / django-storages, where appropriate.

Update file upload, download, retrieval and deletion functionality.

Ensure existing document and media-related APIs function correctly.

Coordinate with DevOps on storage permissions and configuration.

2. PostgreSQL Database Integration

Update Django PostgreSQL database connectivity for AWS RDS PostgreSQL.

Configure environment-based database settings and SSL connectivity.

Verify ORM compatibility, migrations, queries and transactions.

Resolve application-level database connectivity issues.

Ensure existing ERP data operations work correctly.

3. Azure Key Vault to AWS Secrets Manager

Replace Azure Key Vault integration with AWS Secrets Manager or an approved secure environment-variable integration.

Modify Django configuration and secret retrieval logic.

Ensure database credentials, API keys and application secrets are securely accessed.

Remove obsolete Azure-specific dependencies where no longer required.

4. Django REST Framework Backend Updates

Identify and modify Azure-dependent backend code.

Update configuration files, dependencies and environment settings.

Resolve AWS integration-related application errors.

Ensure authentication, permissions, background tasks and existing REST APIs continue functioning.

Maintain backward compatibility wherever applicable.

5. Testing & Validation

Perform backend integration testing.

Validate S3 file operations, PostgreSQL connectivity and secret retrieval.

Test critical Django REST APIs and ERP workflows.

Fix migration-related backend issues.

Support DevOps during deployment and production verification.

Updated Django/DRF backend source code compatible with AWS.

Day 1: Code assessment, storage integration, database connectivity and secrets migration.

Our internal DevOps Engineer handles all AWS infrastructure and deployment activities.
